unlock_add: Add a passkey or security key
unlock_addIntro: Choose what will unlock the vault. Your password keeps working either way.
unlock_addNote: Opens a tab, because your browser’s prompt would close this popup.
unlock_added: Added {name}. Next time, you can unlock Kemlock with it.
unlock_asking: Use your passkey, Windows Hello, Touch ID or security key when your browser asks.
unlock_button: Unlock with a passkey or security key
unlock_done: Unlocked. You can close this tab.
unlock_errorCancelled: It was cancelled or it timed out.
unlock_errorDuplicate: That passkey or key is already added.
unlock_errorFailed: Something went wrong. Try again, or use the password.
unlock_errorLocked: Unlock Kemlock with the password first, then add a passkey.
unlock_errorNoPrf: This passkey or key can’t give Kemlock a secret to unlock with (it has no PRF). Try a security key, or another passkey.
unlock_errorNone: No passkey or security key is set up.
unlock_errorSecurity: The browser refused to use a passkey from this extension.
unlock_errorStale: That passkey no longer matches the vault. Unlock with the password, then add it again.
unlock_errorWrong: That didn’t open the vault. Try again, or use the password.
unlock_kindAny: Let the browser offer the choices
unlock_kindPlatform: This device: Windows Hello, Touch ID or a passkey
unlock_madeAlready: It is made already: only the password is asked again.
unlock_pageTitleAdd: Add a passkey or security key
unlock_passwordDays: It has been two weeks since the vault password was typed. Type it to keep using a passkey.
unlock_passwordHint: Asked so that no one at your open browser can add a key of their own.
unlock_passwordTries: Too many passkey tries failed. Type the vault password.
unlock_removeBody: It will no longer open the vault. The password still does.
unlock_rowDetail: Open the vault with Windows Hello, Touch ID, a passkey or a security key. The password always works too.
unlock_twoPrompts: Your browser will ask twice: once to create it, once to check that it opens the vault.
unlock_unsupported: This browser can’t unlock Kemlock with a passkey or security key, because it doesn’t support the PRF extension this needs. The password still works.
unlock_unsupportedFirefox: Firefox can’t give Kemlock a passkey of its own yet: a passkey made here would also answer to a web page. So passkeys and security keys don’t unlock Kemlock in Firefox. The password does.
